feat.name: Abjuration Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Abjuration Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Protective Ward
entries: When you cast a spell from the Abjuration school using a spell slot, you or one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice the level of spell slot expended.

feat.name: Arcane Artist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Inspiring Magic
entries: When you cast a spell from the Illusion school, you can choose one ally within 30 feet of yourself who can see you. That ally gains {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Arcane Eloquence
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Smooth Talker
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

feat.name: Arcane Infiltrator
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Friends|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Cunning Diversion
entries: You can take the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Arcane Omens
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Guidance|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Helpful Premonition
entries: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself fails a saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the save's total, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Arcane Overload
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Fire Bolt|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Power Surge
entries: When you cast an Evocation spell and deal damage with it, you can add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to one damage roll of that spell. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Arcane Safeguard
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn the {@spell Resistance|XPHB} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast the {@spell Resistance|XPHB} cantrip as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can do so a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sheltering Aid
entries: When you take the {@action Help|XPHB} action to assist with an ally's ability check, that ally gains a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

feat.name: Arcane Undertaker
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cantrip
entries: You learn one Cleric or Wizard cantrip of your choice. The cantrip must be from the Necromancy school. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Knowledge from the Dead
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill History|XPHB}) or Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Understanding of Death
entries: When you take the {@action Help|XPHB} action to stabilize a creature with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Arcane Warrior
entries: You learn two Wizard cantrips of your choice. {@spell Mage Hand|XPHB} and {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} are recommended. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat).
Whenever you gain a level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Wizard cantrip.

feat.name: Boon of Erupting Spellpower
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Spell Overload
entries: When you cast a spell that deals damage using a spell slot, you can cause its magical energy to surge. You can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die rolled for the spell as a 3, and creatures that took damage from the spell also have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} or finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} or {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Boon of Magic School Mastery
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mastered School
entries: Choose one of the eight schools of magic: Abjuration, Conjuration, Divination, Enchantment, Evocation, Illusion, Necromancy, or Transmutation. Your choice grants you the following features:

items.name: Rote Casting
entries: Choose a level 1 spell from the chosen school that appears on your class's spell list. You always have that spell prepared and can cast it without a spell slot or spell components.

items.name: Signature Arcanum
entries: Choose a level 7 or lower spell from the chosen school. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
You can also cast these prepared spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different school of magic each time.

feat.name: Boon of the Iron Mind
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Unshakable Focus
entries: When you are maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB} on an effect, you lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} only if you cast a spell or activate another effect that requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}, if you have the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} or {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, or if you die.

feat.name: Conjuration Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Conjuration Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Persistent Conjuration
entries: While maintaining {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell from the Conjuration school, you gain a bonus to Constitution saving throws to maintain this {@status Concentration|XPHB}. This bonus is equal to the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat.

feat.name: Divination Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Divination Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Prescient Intervention
entries: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to give that creature {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} (your choice) on that roll.

Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also regain use of this feature when you cast a spell from the Divination school using a spell slot.

feat.name: Elemental Familiar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Elemental Energy
entries: You learn how to imbue your familiar with elemental power. When you cast the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. Your familiar is imbued with this energy until you cast {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} again, granting it the following benefits:

entries.name: Elemental Resistance
entries: Your familiar has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type.

entries.name: Energy Pulse
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you command your familiar to unleash a burst of elemental energy. Your familiar must be within 120 feet of you and take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to unleash this burst. Each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from your familiar makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier for the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d4} damage of the chosen type, and if the creature is Medium or smaller, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

feat.name: Enchantment Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Enchantment Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Subtle Enchantments
entries: When you cast a spell from the Enchantment school using a spell slot, you can cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell.

feat.name: Evocation Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Evocation Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Fueled Evocation
entries: Once per turn when you cast an Evocation spell and deal damage, you can roll up to two of your unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} and add the total rolled to one of the spell's damage rolls. Those {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} are then expended.

feat.name: Familiar Friend
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Faithful Companion
entries: You always have the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot or Material components, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

entries.name: Fortified Familiar
entries: When you cast the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell, your familiar's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum and current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} are increased by an amount equal to twice your character level.

entries.name: Helpful Friend
entries: When you make an ability check using a skill in which you have proficiency while your familiar is within 5 feet of you, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the check. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Illusion Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Illusion Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Masterful Illusions
entries: When you cast a spell from the Illusion school using a spell slot, you can cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell. Additionally, creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks made to discern the true nature of illusions created by your spells.

feat.name: Magic Connoisseur
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell from the same list you selected for the Magic Initiate feat's cantrips. You always have those spells prepared. You can cast each spell once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spellcasting ability for these spells is the same as the spellcasting ability chosen for your Magic Initiate feat's spells.

entries.name: Spell Change
entries: Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose for this feat with a different spell of the same level from the chosen spell list.

feat.name: Necromancy Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Necromancy Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Life Manipulation
entries: When you cast a spell from the Necromancy school using a spell slot, you can immediately roll up to two of your unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}. You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total rolled plus the level of spell slot expended. Those {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} are then expended.

feat.name: Otherworldly Familiar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Otherworldly Power
entries: When you cast the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell, you can imbue your familiar with otherworldly might, which lasts until you cast {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} again. While imbued, your familiar gains the following benefits:

entries.name: Energy Resistance
entries: Choose Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder damage. Your familiar has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type.

entries.name: Phase Walk
entries: Your familiar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. If your familiar ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the last unoccupied space it was in.

feat.name: Portal Jumper
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Otherworldly Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one of the following damage types: Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant (choose when you select this feat).

entries.name: Portal Step
entries: You can spend 15 feet of movement to teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of yourself. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} but only once per turn, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Soothing Familiar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Healing Beacon
entries: Positive energy fills a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from your familiar as long as it is within 120 feet of you. Whenever an ally in that {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} rolls a die to determine the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} restored to a creature, that ally can treat a roll of 1 or 2 on the die as a 3.

feat.name: Spell Resistant
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Magical Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one of the following damage types (choose when you gain this feat): Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder.

entries.name: Magic Resistant
entries: When you would fail a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, you can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the save's total, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Spell Subterfuge
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shrouding Spells
entries: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action using a spell slot, you can take both the {@action Dash|XPHB} and {@action Hide|XPHB} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sneaky Casting
entries: If you have the {@action Hide|XPHB} action's {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, casting a spell with a Verbal component or making a spell attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover} or {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover}.

feat.name: Transmutation Adept
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Additional Spells
entries: Your prowess allows you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Transmutation Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

entries.name: Magical Augmentation
entries: On your turn when you cast a spell from the Transmutation school using a spell slot, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by a number of feet equal to five times the level of spell slot expended. This increase lasts until the end of the turn.

feat.name: Transmuted Anatomy
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lengthened Stride
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet.

entries.name: Resilient Anatomy
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that would compel you to shape-shift against your will. Additionally, when you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Warlike Familiar
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Battle Familiar
entries: You always have the {@spell Battle Familiar|AU} spell (see chapter 2) prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the one chosen for the Faithful Companion benefit of your Familiar Friend feat.

entries.name: Intercept Attack
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of your familiar is hit by an attack roll, your familiar can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to add a bonus to the creature's {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss. The bonus is equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.
